# PR risk rules. Read by the PR gate from the base branch (a PR cannot lower its own risk).
#
# Each line: <level> <kind> <pattern>
#   level: high | low        (anything that matches neither is mid)
#   kind:  path  — shell glob on the changed file's path (* also matches /)
#          diff  — regex on the changed lines (+/-) of files that are not low
#          diff-all — the same, but also on low files (except docs/*, *.md): for what must never pass unseen
#
# A file that matches both a high and a low path is high.
# A PR's risk is the highest of its files: any high → high; all files low → low; otherwise mid.
# When unsure, add the file to a higher level.
#
# To see the level of a branch: python3 scripts/pr_risk.py --base origin/main --head <branch>
# (tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py')

# --- high: update, signing, permissions, distribution, redaction/privacy, CI ---
high path .github/*
high path REVIEW.md
# Release tooling (folds changelog.d into CHANGELOG.md, which the apps read for the update prompt)
high path scripts/*
high path macos/Package.swift
high path macos/scripts/*
high path macos/*.entitlements
# Opt-in LaunchAgent installation and automatic relaunch policy
high path macos/Sources/Koe/AutoRestart.swift
high path macos/Sources/Koe/UpdatePrompt.swift
# In-app update: checking the signature of the downloaded app before it replaces Koe (#177)
high path macos/Sources/Koe/UpdateVerify.swift
high path macos/Sources/Koe/Redaction.swift
high path macos/Sources/Koe/Retention.swift
high path windows/build.sh
high path windows/update_windows.go
high path windows/diag_windows.go
high path windows/core/update.go
high path windows/core/updateprompt.go
high path windows/core/download.go
high path windows/core/diag.go
high path windows/core/history.go
high path windows/core/log.go
high path windows/core/retention.go
high path windows/assets/*.manifest
high path windows/go.mod
high path windows/go.sum
# Tests that guard redaction, update and retention: weakening them needs a human
high path macos/Tests/redaction/*
high path macos/Tests/update/*
high path macos/Tests/updateverify/*
high path macos/Tests/history/*
high path windows/core/update_test.go
high path windows/core/updateprompt_test.go
high path windows/core/retention_test.go

# High-risk code inside the big files (main.swift, *_windows.go, ...)
# Asking for a permission (reading whether it is granted is mid)
high diff kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt|requestAccess|tccutil|UsageDescription|com\.apple\.security\.
# Any key added to or removed from Info.plist (a version bump only changes <string> lines and stays mid)
high diff ^\s*<key>
high diff checkForUpdate|releases/(latest|download)|raw\.githubusercontent|huggingface\.co|updateChannel|UpdatePrompt|installUpdate|SUFeedURL
high diff codesign|SecItem|SecKeychain|SIGN_|sign\.sh|hdiutil|INSTALL_DIR|^(install|dist):
# The updater (enum Updater in main.swift) and the signature check it relies on
high diff UpdateVerify|SecStaticCode|SecRequirement|SecCodeCheckValidity|enum Updater\b|Updater\.(install|download|replace)|com\.apple\.quarantine|xattr
# Changing the app's identity (not mentioning it: `defaults write io.github.chaspy.koe ...` in a comment is fine)
high diff CFBundleIdentifier|PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER|bundleIdentifier *=|CFBundleExecutable|^APP_NAME|\$\(BUNDLE\)
high diff [Rr]edact|伏せ
# Where events and history are stored, and the code that writes or deletes them. Reading them, or adding
# an event or a record field, is mid:
# REVIEW.md asks the reviewer to check that no text, title or path goes into it.
high diff SaveHistory|Retention\.prune|pruneHistory|enum (History|Events)\b|appendingPathComponent\("(Koe/)?(events\.jsonl|history)"\)|(write\(to|removeItem\(at|os\.Remove(All)?\().*([Hh]istory|events)
# Where text can leave the machine (eval scripts read the history)
high diff-all [Ee]ndpoint|KOE_OLLAMA
high diff-all urlopen|urllib\.request|requests\.(get|post)|http\.(Post|NewRequest)|URLSession|subprocess\..*(curl|wget)

# --- low: docs, eval, tests, pack terms ---
low path docs/*
low path *.md
low path eval/*
low path macos/Tests/*
low path windows/*_test.go
low path windows/core/testdata/*
low path windows/bench/*
low path packs/*.txt
